findings.decision_broken: no record of processing (ConfigMap gdpr-processing) in the namespace
findings.observed: present=False, name=gdpr-processing
findings.fix: kubectl create configmap gdpr-processing --from-literal=controller=<team> --from-literal=purpose=<why> --from-literal=lawful_basis=<art.6 basis> --from-literal=categories=<email,name,...|none> --from-literal=retention_days=<n> --from-literal=erasure_path=</api/<collection>/{id}>
